tools.name: didtheyopen_signup
tools.description: Create a didtheyopen account (no email needed). Use only when no agent key is set for this server (Authorization header). Returns an agent key for this server and a dashboard login for the owner, shown once.

tools.name: didtheyopen_track_email
tools.description: Get a tracking pixel for ONE email the owner asked to track. Returns an tag to put at the end of the HTML body before sending, and, given the links of the email (pass them by default), a tracked address for each link. tools.name: didtheyopen_account
tools.description: Plan, trial emails left, whether new emails can be tracked, today usage, and upgrade links.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "didtheyopen_signup" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "didtheyopen_new_opens" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: didtheyopen_track_email, didtheyopen_check_email, didtheyopen_new_opens · Public sink: didtheyopen_signup, didtheyopen_track_email, didtheyopen_check_email, didtheyopen_new_opens · Destructive: didtheyopen_new_opens.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: didtheyopen_track_email, didtheyopen_check_email, didtheyopen_new_opens · Public sink: didtheyopen_signup, didtheyopen_track_email, didtheyopen_check_email, didtheyopen_new_opens · Destructive: didtheyopen_new_opens

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
